purpose: Fresh questions for validation of the fixed topic-preserving query transformation; results not yet observed.
annotation_policy: A relevant chunk must contain sufficient evidence to answer the whole question. Overlapping duplicate evidence is accepted. Questions and reference answers are source-relative. Labels were drafted by an assistant from all 70 supplied chunks and await user review. Evidence excerpts are literal review anchors, not necessarily the complete answer.
corpus_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({chunk_id: exact_text}, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma, colon)).
planned_comparison: Compare unmodified queries with the fixed topic-preserving rule on all cases and separately on the 5 modified cases. The 5 natural controls must remain identical.
predeclared_interpretation: On this small validation set, require no loss of Hit@3 and inspect every regression before considering adoption. Higher MRR@5 alone is insufficient. Do not retune the rule using these results and continue describing this set as unseen.
limitations: 10 source-relative answerable questions, one per existing video.
New questions drawn from a corpus already inspected during development, not an independent clinical or external benchmark.
Assistant-drafted labels await human review before the first retrieval run.
5 source-prefixed queries test the transformation; 5 natural queries test unchanged behavior.
No retrieval results or answer-generation scores have been measured for these cases.

cases.query: According to the acute dyspnea lecture, how does respiratory compensation respond to metabolic acidosis?
cases.reference_answer: Respiratory drive increases to lower arterial CO2 below normal and partially normalize pH.

cases.query: According to the acute abdominal pain lecture, what physical examination finding is called Murphy's sign?
